name: baby-proofing checklist
pitch: Make a room-by-room baby-proofing checklist for a crawling nine-month-old.
instructions: Start by searching the web for a baby-proofing checklist for a crawling nine-month-old. When results appear, open the most relevant page. Read the page and note the room-by-room items listed. If no checklist is found, search again with different terms like "room by room baby safety checklist crawling". When you have the items, list them in a table with two columns: room and safety item. If a room has no specific items, leave that cell blank. After the table is complete, create a simple text document with the same list. Name the file baby-proofing-checklist.txt. Show the table and the file name to the person. When nothing is found after two searches, say so and ask if they want to try different terms.

readme:
# baby-proofing checklist

Create a room-by-room baby-proofing checklist for a crawling nine-month-old.

**What it does**
Searches the web for a ready-made checklist, extracts the room-by-room items, shows them in a table, and saves a text file with the same list.

**What it needs**
Web search and browser tools. No mail, calendar, or file system access beyond writing the output file.

**What it will not do**
It will not give medical advice, recommend specific products by brand, or charge for any service.
